name: MAST 3991
title: Supervised Internship in Maritime Studies
description: Internship with institutions, businesses, or agencies engaged in areas directly related to Maritime Studies. Maritime Studies faculty supervisor, student, and field supervisor of host organization will jointly define a specific project to advance student's educational program as well as mission of the host institution. Grades will be based on performance of the learning contract and a final academic product. May be repeated for credit with change in content and program coordinator's consent. May be repeated for a total of 15 credits.
requirement_description: Completion of 9 credits of Maritime Studies core courses, and consent of the program coordinator.
